statement.zh-TW: 只要資產負債表左右兩邊的合計相等，表上的每一個數字就一定都是對的。
statement.en: As long as the two sides of a balance sheet add up to the same total, every figure on the sheet must be right.

feedbackTrue.zh-TW: 左右相等確實是第一道檢查，這點沒錯。不過它只能抓到「漏記一邊」的錯誤：如果把一台設備記成存貨，兩邊的合計還是一樣高，表卻已經錯了。
feedbackTrue.en: Equal totals are indeed the first check, that much is right. But it only catches errors that miss one side: if a machine is recorded as inventory, both totals stay the same, yet the sheet is already wrong.

feedbackFalse.zh-TW: 答對了。平衡只表示每一筆交易都記了兩邊；科目放錯、金額記錯但兩邊一起錯，表仍然會平衡。
feedbackFalse.en: That is right. Balancing only shows that every transaction was recorded on both sides; a wrong account, or a wrong amount entered on both sides, still leaves the sheet balanced.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_cfghjxzq}}是必要條件，不是充分條件：不平衡一定有錯，平衡卻不保證全對。讀表的人還要看每個科目放的位置和金額合不合理。
explanation.en: The {{term:tm_cfghjxzq}} is a necessary condition, not a sufficient one: an unbalanced sheet is certainly wrong, but a balanced one is not guaranteed to be right. A reader still has to check whether each account sits in the right place with a sensible amount.
